We, Tyler and Marla Litwiller, as the owners of this small town Feed Mill, have a goal to provide quality feeds at affordable prices for all your animals. We carry ​ Purina , Vita Plus , IDO, and FAMO feeds. We make custom feed for horses, sheep, calves, beef, and goats with help from our nutritional staff. We also offer Legend Seeds and Alforex Low-Lignin alfalfa seed for all of your planting needs! Stop by today and we will be happy to do business with you! ​ ​
|
HOURS
MONDAY - FRIDAY: 8:00 - 5:00
SATURDAY: 9:00 - NOON
SUNDAY: CLOSED​
Credit card, Debit card, Cash, or Check accepted.
​(We off a 2% Cash Discount if you pay by Cash or Check) ​
​More than just a feed store -
We're your One-Stop Shop!
We have a large variety of Bird Seed available.
Black Oil Sunflower in 50# or 25# or 10# bags, plus numerous other bird seed mixes.
We also carry Gamebird Feed, Goat Feed, Meat Bird & Layer Feed, Hog Starter & Hog Finisher, Calf Feed, All-Stock Feed, Horse Feed, Pigeon Feed, Deer Feed & Deer Mineral, Rabbit Pellets, Lamb Starter & Grower, Dog & Cat Food. Hen Treats, Dog Treats. Milk Replacers.
We feature Smart Lic, FAMO Balance Builder, and Purina Wind-N-Rain Tubs -
60# and 225# and 250# Lic Tubs - call for the options!
We also carry many non-feed products like gates, corral panels, mineral feeders, hay bale rings, stock tanks, small animal feeders, waterers, bottles, pest control, scoops, and some medications.
Lawn Seed, Pasture Seed, Food Plot Seed & Triple 17 and Triple 10 fertilizers are also available in season.
If we don't have it on the floor, we'll do our best to get it for you.
